title: Connectors
description: Bring your organization's jobs and candidates into Workatent from the tools you already use. Connect once; Workatent keeps them in sync and never changes anything in the source.

greenhouse.tagline: Import the open jobs from a Greenhouse job board.
greenhouse.description: Reads the jobs your client (or your agency) publishes on Greenhouse and keeps them up to date. Only the board name is needed: no password, no API key.
greenhouse.does1: Imports every published job with its description, location and work arrangement.
greenhouse.does2: Updates jobs when they change and pauses them when they're taken down.
greenhouse.step1: Open the company's Greenhouse careers page.
greenhouse.step2: Copy the name after boards.greenhouse.io/ in the address (for example, "acme").
greenhouse.step3: Paste it below, test, and connect.

board.label: Board name
board.hint: You can also paste the whole link.

lever.tagline: Import the open jobs from a Lever careers site.
lever.description: Reads the postings published on a Lever careers site, including salary ranges when they're shown. Only the site name is needed.
lever.does1: Imports every published posting with its description, team, location and salary range.
lever.does2: Updates postings when they change and pauses them when they're taken down.
lever.step1: Open the company's Lever careers page (jobs.lever.co/…).
lever.step2: Copy the name after jobs.lever.co/ (for example, "acme"). Sites on jobs.eu.lever.co use the Europe region.
lever.step3: Paste it below, test, and connect.

site.label: Site name
site.hint: You can also paste the whole link.

region.label: Region
region.hint: Where the careers site is hosted.

ashby.tagline: Import the open jobs from an Ashby job board.
ashby.description: Reads the jobs listed on an Ashby job board, with compensation when it's published. Only the board name is needed.
ashby.does1: Imports every listed job with its description, location, employment type and salary.
ashby.does2: Updates jobs when they change and pauses them when they're unlisted.
ashby.step1: Open the company's Ashby job board (jobs.ashbyhq.com/…).
ashby.step2: Copy the name after jobs.ashbyhq.com/ (for example, "acme").
ashby.step3: Paste it below, test, and connect.

board.label: Board name
board.hint: You can also paste the whole link.

workable.tagline: Import the open jobs from a Workable careers page.
workable.description: Reads the jobs published on a Workable careers page. Only the account name is needed.
workable.does1: Imports every published job with its description, location and employment type.
workable.does2: Updates jobs when they change and pauses them when they're taken down.
workable.step1: Open the company's Workable careers page (apply.workable.com/…).
workable.step2: Copy the name after apply.workable.com/ (for example, "acme").
workable.step3: Paste it below, test, and connect.

subdomain.label: Account name
subdomain.hint: You can also paste the whole link.

google_sheets.tagline: Keep candidates or jobs in sync with a Google Sheet.
google_sheets.description: Reads a Google Sheet your team keeps up to date and imports its rows. Column names are recognised in English, Portuguese, French and Spanish, so most sheets work as they are.
google_sheets.does1: Imports each row as a candidate or a job; repeated rows update instead of duplicating.
google_sheets.does2: Matches people you already have by email or LinkedIn and only fills what's missing.
google_sheets.step1: In Google Sheets, click Share and set "Anyone with the link" to Viewer.
google_sheets.step2: Copy the link. The first row must hold the column names (download a template from the CSV connector).
google_sheets.step3: Paste it below, choose what the sheet holds, test, and connect.

url.label: Sheet link
url.hint: Each tab has its own link: open the tab you want before copying.

entity.label: The sheet holds
entity.hint: One kind of record per sheet or file.

csv_upload.tagline: Upload a CSV of candidates or jobs, exported from Excel or any tool.
csv_upload.description: A one-off import from a file. Export from Excel, your ATS or any spreadsheet as CSV and upload it here.
csv_upload.does1: Imports each row as a candidate or a job, as private drafts.
csv_upload.does2: Matches people you already have by email or LinkedIn and only fills what's missing.
csv_upload.step1: Download the template, or use your own file: the first row must hold the column names.
csv_upload.step2: In Excel: File → Save as → CSV UTF-8.
csv_upload.step3: Upload it below. Rows with problems are listed so you can fix and re-upload them.

entity.label: The file holds
entity.hint: One kind of record per sheet or file.

workatent_api.tagline: Send candidates and jobs from your own systems, Zapier or Make.
workatent_api.description: A simple REST API for your developers or no-code tools. Create a key, send JSON, and records appear in your organization.
workatent_api.does1: Creates and updates candidates and jobs; your own ids make repeated calls safe.
workatent_api.does2: Assigns records to a teammate by email, or to the key's creator.

messages.connected: Connected. The first import has started.
messages.syncQueued: Sync started. This page shows the result in a moment.
messages.disconnected: Disconnected. Imported records stay in your organization.
messages.keyCreated: API key created. Copy it now: it won't be shown again.

errors.httpsOnly: Use a link that starts with https://
errors.notFound: Nothing was found there. Check the name, and for a Google Sheet that "Anyone with the link" can view it.
errors.unreachable: The source didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.invalidConfig: Check the name or link: it doesn't look right.
errors.badFormat: The source answered in an unexpected format.
errors.missingColumn: The first row needs a column for {column}. Download the template to see the expected columns.
errors.empty: The source has nothing to import right now.
errors.internal: The last sync failed. It will be retried automatically.
errors.fileSize: The file must be at most 5 MB.
errors.csvOnly: Upload a .csv file. In Excel: File → Save as → CSV UTF-8.
errors.keyName: Give the key a name of 2 to 80 characters.
errors.notFoundKey: This key doesn't exist or was already revoked.

connection.disconnectDescription: Workatent stops syncing it. Candidates and jobs already imported stay in your organization and can be edited as usual.

detail.never: Never changes or deletes anything in the source.
detail.privacyCandidates: Imported candidates arrive as private drafts. They can't be matched or shared with partners until a recruiter confirms the privacy notice and records the candidate's authorization.
detail.privacyJobs: Imported jobs belong to your organization and are never shown to partners until you activate them and open them to partners.
detail.soonBody: The {name} connector is in development. Until it's ready, you can send records from {name} with the Workatent API (or Zapier/Make), or export them to a spreadsheet.
detail.adminOnly: Only organization admins and recruiter managers can connect sources.

upload.title: Upload a file
upload.columnsHint: Column names in English, Portuguese, French or Spanish are recognised.

api.keysBody: Each key works for this organization only. Records sent with a key belong to the person who created it, unless you send ownerEmail.
api.keyNameHint: Where it will be used, so you can tell keys apart.
api.copyNow: Copy this key now. For your security it won't be shown again.
api.revokeDescription: Anything using this key stops working immediately. This can't be undone.
api.docsBody: Send JSON to these endpoints. Send one object, or up to 100 in { "items": [ … ] }.
api.limitsValue: 120 requests per minute per key · 100 items per request · 1 MB per request
api.note1: Send externalId (your system's id): repeating a call updates the record instead of duplicating it.
api.note2: Candidates already in your organization are matched by email or LinkedIn; only empty fields are filled.
api.note3: GET /candidates and GET /jobs list records (limit, page, updated_since). GET /me checks a key.
api.note4: Invalid items return 422 with the index and field of each problem, and nothing is saved.
